parsed.explanation: Section 3 proves only that g has at most one positive value. The write-up never excludes negative values: §1 states merely g(x)>-x, and later arguments assume without proof that V⊆{0,c}. A single sentence completing the orbit argument would repair this: induction from (3) gives f^n(t)=t+n g(t)>0 for every n≥0, which forces g(t)≥0. Without that sentence or an equivalent argument, L5.3 and the subsequent dichotomy are not established as written.
